tasks.subject: [local-playwright-browser] [P1] Prove exact embedded Playwright control
tasks.description: Build an isolated Electron 41 WebContentsView fixture using pinned playwright-core 1.63.0 and local HTTP pages. Implement the candidate page-only debugger transport, then use real Playwright navigation, snapshot, locator click and fill against the visible native view. Prove human keyboard/mouse input remains usable, a second page and shell are unreachable, stale references are rejected and teardown releases owned resources. No synthetic shim clicks, duplicate browser, exposed application evaluation or inference. Record resolved versions and evidence; block dependent embedded implementation if this does not pass.

tasks.subject: [local-playwright-browser] [P1] Define local browser ownership and action contracts
tasks.description: Add versioned Zod contracts and a narrow engine port for embedded/new-window modes, capabilities, explicit session/page identities, readable status/title/URL, pause flag, generation/observation revision and safe errors. Use existing shared Transport and authenticated Hono request chain with readJsonBody and honoRequestFacts. Keep this registry separate from old VM/streaming custody. Agent commands must reject foreign IDs and stale generation. Tests prove cross-session denial, unsupported defaults and strict argument validation. Record panel/PiP and runtime owner agreements.

tasks.subject: [local-playwright-browser] [P2] Ship persistent separate browser windows
tasks.description: Implement headed Playwright persistent Chromium using the exact executable revision supported by 1.63.0 and a reserved DorkOS-owned data directory. Include library in CLI/desktop runtime dependencies and manage automatic executable acquisition with bounded progress, cancellation, retry, revision validation and cache reuse. Never require manual Playwright install, npx or personal data copying. Preserve saved site data across restart and upgrade; reject concurrent directory writers. Test local cookie continuity, missing executable, bad revision, download refusal, insufficient disk and owned cleanup.

tasks.subject: [local-playwright-browser] [P2] Host the embedded desktop browser
tasks.description: Implement sandboxed WebContentsView ownership in desktop main with a dedicated persistent partition, no Node integration or shell preload, and the proven page-only transport. Register only owned frames/workers; deny shell/root/browser target access. Connect bounds/visibility/focus to the panel owner contract, including resize, collapse, route changes, dialogs and window close. Register or clearly reject popup pages. Preserve same page identity during supported presentation moves; never duplicate or stream as PiP fallback. Native fixtures verify visible action effects, manual input, target denial and release on close.

tasks.subject: [local-playwright-browser] [P3] Expose scoped live-page tools and Pause
tasks.description: Add validated runtime tools for bounded page selection, navigation, snapshot/screenshot, click/fill/key/scroll and observation without arbitrary evaluation, Playwright code, shell, raw network or debugger commands. Coordinate runtime owner and remove old npx/headless copied-state binding for new mode selection. Serialize agent mutations while native human input stays live. Pause rejects new/queued mutations; dispatched effects return known or unknown results without replay. Check observation revision/element binding immediately before input and stop stale auto-wait from acting in a new document. Test timeout after form submission, human navigation, transport loss, pause race and resume requiring fresh observation. Audit excludes filled values/secrets.

tasks.subject: [local-playwright-browser] [P3] Present two plain-language browser choices
tasks.description: Implement exactly DorkOS browser and New browser window through the agreed resource-tab/right-panel contract. Embedded is desktop default where supported; New browser window is local npm default, and embedded choice explains Requires the DorkOS desktop app. Show readable chosen browser/tab/title/URL and agent. Provide open/disconnect/reconnect, Preparing browser, Pause agent/Resume agent, Browser closed, Page changed and Action result unknown recovery. Every app block is at most 15 words with no profile/CDP/provider jargon. Keep keyboard/focus/screen reader behavior and responsive controls. No iframe duplicate or competing tab registry. Browser tests prove labels, defaults, recovery and Pause.

tasks.subject: [local-playwright-browser] [P4] Prove installed CLI and desktop behavior
tasks.description: Pack CLI tarball and isolated desktop artifact; record hashes and resolved Playwright/Electron/browser revisions. Install CLI into clean isolated data/work directory without repository node_modules or npx. Prove included library, automatic first executable acquisition and offline cache reuse, visible persistent separate window and selected-page operation. Run packaged desktop exact-WebContentsView fixture plus new browser window with separate app-data directory. Exercise human input, saved-logins restart, pause/navigation/unknown-effect and cleanup ownership. No inference or changes to personal installed DorkOS0.114.1/browser data. Document actual platform coverage and keep untested claims gated.

tasks.subject: [local-playwright-browser] [P4] Document and independently verify delivery
tasks.description: Update browser docs and obsolete signed-in-browser/CLI help around two choices, included library versus browser preparation, platform limits, saved logins, disconnect, Pause and unknown-action recovery. Remove superseded competing paths while preserving applicable preview shim behavior. Root maintains spec/ADR manifests and tracker evidence. Run targeted meaningful typecheck/lint/tests and appropriate affected verification and protected CI; complete independent review, normal commit/push hooks and protected merge. Record proof limits honestly, resolve review findings, and clean only creator-owned resources after completion. Both modes and installed-package proof remain completion requirements.
